verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לֵאמֹֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And God spoke all these . . . words
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO falou Deus todas estas palavras, dizendo:

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִ֖י֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣֥ית עֲבָדִיֽ֑ם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mib·bêṯ ʿă·ḇå̄·ḏīm
verses.literal: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt out of the house of slavery
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão.

verses.original: לֹֽ֣א יִהְיֶֽה־ לְךָ֛֩ אֱלֹהִ֥֨ים אֲחֵרִ֖֜ים עַל־ פָּנָֽ֗יַ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yih·yeh- lə·ḵå̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ‘al- på̄·nå̄·ya
verses.literal: You shall have no other gods before Me
verses.literalPt: Não terás outros deuses diante de mim.

verses.transliteration: lō ṯa·‘ă·śeh- lə·ḵā p̄ɛ·sɛl wə·ḵāl tə·mū·nāh ʾă·šɛr baš·šå̄·ma·yim mim·ma·‘al wa·’ă·šer bā·’ā·reṣ mit·tå̄·ḥaṯ wa·’ă·šer bam·ma·yim mit·ta·ḥaṯ lå̄·ʾå̄·rɛṣ
verses.literal: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above on the earth below or in the waters beneath . . .
verses.literalPt: Não farás para ti imagem de escultura, nem alguma semelhança do que há em cima nos céus, nem em baixo na terra, nem nas águas debaixo da terra.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִשְׁתַּחְוֶ֥֣ה לָהֶ֖ם֮ וְלֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑ם֒ כִּ֣י אָֽנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָבֹ֧ת עַל־ בָּנִ֛ים עַל־ שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל־ רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽ֑י׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiš·taḥ·wɛh lā·hem wə·lō ṯā·‘ā·ḇə·ḏêm kî ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’êl qan·nā pō·qêḏ ‘ă·wōn ’ā·ḇōṯ ‘al- bā·nîm ‘al- šil·lê·šîm wə·‘al- rib·bê·‘îm lə·śō·nə·ʾå̄y
verses.literal: You shall not bow down to them or worship them for I the LORD your God am a jealous God visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third . . . and fourth generations of those who hate Me
verses.literalPt: Não te encurvarás a elas nem as servirás; porque eu, o SENHOR teu Deus, sou Deus zeloso, que visito a iniqüidade dos pais nos filhos, até a terceira e quarta geração daqueles que me odeiam.

verses.original: וְעֹ֥֤שֶׂה חֶ֖֙סֶד֙ לַאֲלָפִ֑֔ים לְאֹהֲבַ֖י וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·śeh ḥe·seḏ la·’ă·lā·p̄îm lə·’ō·hă·ḇay ū·lə·šō·mə·rê miṣ·wō·ṯāy
verses.literal: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments
verses.literalPt: E faço misericórdia a milhares dos que me amam e aos que guardam os meus mandamentos.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת־ שֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַשָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō ṯiś·śā ’eṯ- šêm- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā laš·šāw kî lō yə·naq·qeh Yah·weh ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yiś·śā ’eṯ- šə·mōw laš·šāw
verses.literal: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain
verses.literalPt: Não tomarás o nome do SENHOR teu Deus em vão; porque o SENHOR não terá por inocente o que tomar o seu nome em vão.

verses.original: זָכ֛וֹר֩ אֶת־ י֥֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖֜ת לְקַדְּשֽׁ֗וֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵō·wr ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ lə·qad·də·šō
verses.literal: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te do dia do sábado, para o santificar.

verses.original: שֵׁ֤֣שֶׁת יָמִ֣ים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד֮ וְעָשִׂ֖֣יתָ כָּל־ מְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ֒׃
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm ta·ʿă·ḇōḏ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā kāl- mə·laḵ·tɛ·ḵå̄
verses.literal: Six days you shall labor and do all your work
verses.literalPt: Seis dias trabalharás, e farás toda a tua obra.

verses.original: וְי֙וֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔֜י שַׁבָּ֖֣ת׀ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑֗יךָ לֹֽ֣א־ תַעֲשֶׂ֣֨ה כָל־ מְלָאכָ֡֜ה אַתָּ֣ה׀ וּבִנְךָֽ֣־ וּ֠בִתֶּ֗ךָ עַבְדְּךָ֤֨ וַאֲמָֽתְךָ֜֙ וּבְהֶמְתֶּ֔֗ךָ וְגֵרְךָ֖֙ אֲשֶׁ֥֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶֽ֔יךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î šab·bāṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō- ṯa·‘ă·śeh ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh ’at·tāh ū·ḇin·ḵå̄- ū·ḇit·te·ḵā ‘aḇ·də·ḵā wa·’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇə·hem·te·ḵā wə·ḡê·rə·ḵā ’ă·šer biš·ʿå̄·rɛ·ḵå̄
verses.literal: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God on which you must not do any work neither you nor your son or daughter nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock nor the foreigner within your gates
verses.literalPt: Mas o sétimo dia é o sábado do SENHOR teu Deus; não farás nenhuma obra, nem tu, nem teu filho, nem tua filha, nem o teu servo, nem a tua serva, nem o teu animal, nem o teu estrangeiro, que está dentro das tuas portas.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שֵֽׁשֶׁת־ יָמִים֩ עָשָׂ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ הַיָּם֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֔ם וַיָּ֖נַח בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י עַל־ כֵּ֗ן בֵּרַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ י֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת וַֽיְקַדְּשֵֽׁהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî šê·šeṯ- yā·mîm ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- hay·yām wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- bām way·yā·naḥ bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ‘al- kên bê·raḵ Yah·weh ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ way·qad·də·šê·hū
verses.literal: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them but on the seventh day He rested Therefore . . . the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy
verses.literalPt: Porque em seis dias fez o SENHOR os céus e a terra, o mar e tudo que neles há, e ao sétimo dia descansou; portanto abençoou o SENHOR o dia do sábado, e o santificou.

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֥ד אֶת־ אָבִ֖יךָ וְאֶת־ אִמֶּ֑ךָ לְמַ֙עַן֙ יַאֲרִכ֣וּן יָמֶ֔יךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kab·bêḏ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’eṯ- ’im·me·ḵā lə·ma·‘an ya·’ă·ri·ḵūn yā·me·ḵā ‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: Honor your father and mother so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you
verses.literalPt: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, para que se prolonguem os teus dias na terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá.

verses.transliteration: lō tir·ṣå̄ḥ
verses.literal: You shall not murder
verses.literalPt: Não matarás.

verses.transliteration: lō tin·ʾå̄p̄
verses.literal: You shall not commit adultery
verses.literalPt: Não adulterarás.

verses.transliteration: lō tiḡ·nōḇ
verses.literal: You shall not steal
verses.literalPt: Não furtarás.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תַעֲנֶ֥ה בְרֵעֲךָ֖ עֵ֥ד שָֽׁקֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·neh ḇə·rê·‘ă·ḵā ‘êḏ šā·qer
verses.literal: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor
verses.literalPt: Não dirás falso testemunho contra o teu próximo.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֑ךָ לֹֽא־ תַחְמֹ֞ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֗ךָ וְעַבְדּ֤וֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ֙ וְשׁוֹר֣וֹ וַחֲמֹר֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְרֵעֶֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō ṯaḥ·mōḏ bêṯ rê·‘e·ḵā lō- ṯaḥ·mōḏ ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘e·ḵā wə·‘aḇ·dōw wa·’ă·mā·ṯōw wə·šō·w·rōw wa·ḥă·mō·rōw wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer lə·rê·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife or his manservant or maidservant or his ox or donkey or anything that belongs to your neighbor
verses.literalPt: Não cobiçarás a casa do teu próximo, não cobiçarás a mulher do teu próximo, nem o seu servo, nem a sua serva, nem o seu boi, nem o seu jumento, nem coisa alguma do teu próximo.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הָעָם֩ רֹאִ֨ים אֶת־ הַקּוֹלֹ֜ת וְאֶת־ הַלַּפִּידִ֗ם וְאֵת֙ ק֣וֹל הַשֹּׁפָ֔ר וְאֶת־ הָהָ֖ר עָשֵׁ֑ן וַיַּ֤רְא הָעָם֙ וַיָּנֻ֔עוּ וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ מֵֽרָחֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām rō·’îm ’eṯ- haq·qō·w·lōṯ wə·’eṯ- hal·lap·pî·ḏim wə·’êṯ qō·wl haš·šō·p̄ār wə·’eṯ- hā·hār ‘ā·šên way·yar hā·‘ām way·yā·nu·‘ū way·ya·‘am·ḏū mê·rā·ḥōq
verses.literal: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning the sounding of the ram’s horn and the mountain enveloped in smoke - they trembled and stood at a distance
verses.literalPt: E todo o povo viu os trovões e os relâmpagos, e o sonido da buzina, e o monte fumegando; e o povo, vendo isso retirou-se e pôs-se de longe.

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה דַּבֵּר־ אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּ֖נוּ וְנִשְׁמָ֑עָה וְאַל־ יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּ֛נוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים פֶּן־ נָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- mō·šeh dab·bêr- ’at·tāh ‘im·mā·nū wə·niš·mā·‘āh wə·’al- yə·ḏab·bêr ‘im·mā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm pen- nā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Speak to us yourself and we will listen they said to Moses But do not let God speak to us or we will die
verses.literalPt: E disseram a Moisés: Fala tu conosco, e ouviremos: e não fale Deus conosco, para que não morramos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל־ הָעָם֮ אַל־ תִּירָאוּ֒ כִּ֗י לְבַֽעֲבוּר֙ נַסּ֣וֹת אֶתְכֶ֔ם בָּ֖א הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבַעֲב֗וּר תִּהְיֶ֧ה יִרְאָת֛וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְבִלְתִּ֥י תֶחֱטָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- hā·‘ām ’al- tî·rā·’ū kî lə·ḇa·‘ă·ḇūr nas·sō·wṯ ’eṯ·ḵem bā hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇa·‘ă·ḇūr tih·yeh yir·’ā·ṯōw ‘al- pə·nê·ḵem lə·ḇil·tî ṯe·ḥĕ·ṭā·’ū
verses.literal: Do not be afraid Moses replied - For God has come to test you so that . . . the fear of Him may be before you to keep you from sinning
verses.literalPt: E disse Moisés ao povo: Não temais, Deus veio para vos provar, e para que o seu temor esteja diante de vós, afim de que não pequeis.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד הָעָ֖ם מֵרָחֹ֑ק וּמֹשֶׁה֙ נִגַּ֣שׁ אֶל־ הָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ hā·‘ām mê·rā·ḥōq ū·mō·šeh nig·gaš ’el- hā·‘ă·rā·p̄el ’ă·šer- šām hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached . . . the thick darkness where . . . God was
verses.literalPt: E o povo estava em pé de longe. Moisés, porém, se chegou à escuridão, onde Deus estava.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמַ֖ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם כִּ֚י מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh kōh ṯō·mar ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’at·tem rə·’î·ṯem kî min- haš·šā·ma·yim dib·bar·tî ‘im·mā·ḵem
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses This is what you are to tell . . . the Israelites . . . You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven
verses.literalPt: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: Vós tendes visto que, dos céus, eu falei convosco.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּן אִתִּ֑י אֱלֹ֤הֵי כֶ֙סֶף֙ וֵאלֹהֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯa·‘ă·śūn ’it·tî ’ĕ·lō·hê ḵe·sep̄ wê·lō·hê zā·hāḇ lō ṯa·‘ă·śū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: You are not to make any gods alongside Me you are not to make for yourselves gods of silver or gold
verses.literalPt: Não fareis outros deuses comigo; deuses de prata ou deuses de ouro não fareis para vós.

verses.original: מִזְבַּ֣ח אֲדָמָה֮ תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לִּי֒ וְזָבַחְתָּ֣ עָלָ֗יו אֶת־ עֹלֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ וְאֶת־ שְׁלָמֶ֔יךָ אֶת־ צֹֽאנְךָ֖ וְאֶת־ בְּקָרֶ֑ךָ בְּכָל־ הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַזְכִּ֣יר אֶת־ שְׁמִ֔י אָב֥וֹא אֵלֶ֖יךָ וּבֵרַכְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·baḥ ’ă·ḏā·māh ta·‘ă·śeh- lî wə·zā·ḇaḥ·tā ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- ‘ō·lō·ṯe·ḵā wə·’eṯ- šə·lā·me·ḵā ’eṯ- ṣō·nə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- bə·qā·re·ḵā bə·ḵāl ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer ’az·kîr ’eṯ- šə·mî ’ā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·ḵā ū·ḇê·raḵ·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: You are to make for Me an altar of earth and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings your sheep and goats and cattle In every place where I cause My name to be remembered I will come to you and bless you
verses.literalPt: Um altar de terra me farás, e sobre ele sacrificarás os teus holocaustos, e as tuas ofertas pacíficas, as tuas ovelhas, e as tuas vacas; em todo o lugar, onde eu fizer celebrar a memória do meu nome, virei a ti e te abençoarei.

verses.original: וְאִם־ מִזְבַּ֤ח אֲבָנִים֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ לִּ֔י לֹֽא־ תִבְנֶ֥ה אֶתְהֶ֖ן גָּזִ֑ית כִּ֧י חַרְבְּךָ֛ הֵנַ֥פְתָּ עָלֶ֖יהָ וַתְּחַֽלְלֶֽהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- miz·baḥ ’ă·ḇā·nîm ta·‘ă·śeh- lî lō- ṯiḇ·neh ’eṯ·hen gā·zîṯ kî ḥar·bə·ḵā hê·nap̄·tā ‘ā·le·hā wat·tə·ḥal·le·hā
verses.literal: Now if you make an altar of stones for Me you must not build it with stones shaped by tools for if you use a chisel on it you will defile it
verses.literalPt: E se me fizeres um altar de pedras, não o farás de pedras lavradas; se sobre ele levantares o teu buril, profaná-lo-ás.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תַעֲלֶ֥ה בְמַעֲלֹ֖ת עַֽל־ מִזְבְּחִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ תִגָּלֶ֥ה עֶרְוָתְךָ֖ עָלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯa·‘ă·leh ḇə·ma·‘ă·lōṯ ‘al- miz·bə·ḥî ’ă·šer lō- ṯig·gā·leh ‘er·wā·ṯə·ḵā ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: And you must not go up to My altar on steps lest your nakedness be exposed on it
verses.literalPt: Também não subirás ao meu altar por degraus, para que a tua nudez não seja descoberta diante deles.
